design: Coastline sharpening after fragmentation: both shores from shared curvilinear rift centerline, varying positive widths, local shifts, current-clip-aware shoreline halo, less regular candidate island spacing.
v220_error_fixed: V2.20 coastline halo followed original uncut continent outlines and could visually cross new water gaps; V2.21 clips all halo to current fragmented subpolygons, with additional rift-edge halos.
qa_notes: The generated clip polygons are visual vector masks, not actual topological coastline reconstructions.
Mask edge data and each rift edge line use the same path points. Variation in opposite shores is correlated.
Depth-looking blue coloring is illustrative only; it is not a modeled sea-floor raster.
Original relief was conserved; true basin-dependent uplift and rivers have not been recomputed.
25 official seas remain unassigned to chart space; archipelago islands are not the official 32 chains of 碎洋.
